question: Will President Trump deliver a national address substantially focused on AI between September 14–18, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if, between September 14 and September 18, 2026 (UTC), President Trump delivers a formal national address — broadcast live to a national audience via television, radio, or official White House video stream — in which artificial intelligence is the primary or predominant subject matter (i.e., the address is substantially and explicitly focused on AI policy, AI strategy, or related AI themes, not merely a passing mention of AI within a broader speech).
- "No": Wins if no such address is delivered by the end of September 18, 2026 (UTC).

Clarifications:
- "National address" means a pre-announced, formal presidential address directed at the general American public in its entirety (e.g., an Oval Office address, a prime-time national speech, or an address to a joint session of Congress), and excludes press gaggles, interview remarks, campaign rallies, remarks at private events, or incidental public statements.
- "Substantially focused on AI" means AI is the central, dominant topic of the address, rather than one of many comparably significant topics discussed.
